title: Lecture 2 — scalar product, orthogonality, and cross product
summary: Sections 1.2 and 4.3: angles, perpendicularity, and cross products.
body:
Study scalar products, orthogonality, angles, and cross products (Sections 1.2 and 4.3). This guide follows the published topic outline; it is not a class transcript.

Read the [Module 1 guide and recommended exercises](https://canvas.kth.se/courses/65269/pages/1-vector-geometry), including the [reading and exercise PDF](https://canvas.kth.se/courses/65269/files/10687612).
